capabilities: Generate a definition of the note's topic with the OpenAI GPT-3 API
Append the generated text to the end of the current note
Build the prompt from the file title and the note's tags
Configure the status text added after generation
disambiguation: Not a dictionary or word-lookup tool; it generates a definition from the note's title and tags via the OpenAI API.
extras: Note: README says GPT-3, while the plugin name references ChatGPT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate an explanation or definition of a note's topic automatically.

relations.evidence: generate text using the OPENAI GPT-3 API

summary: AI command that generates a definition for the current note's topic via the OpenAI GPT-3 API and appends it to the file.
